name: Escape Green
notes: Escape Green 0.3.0. Each biome has a village (Vine Hollow, Sunwell, Frostpine, and Cloverfold) with protected walkable buildings, friendly villagers, F-to-talk lines, and coin trades (bread for 5, a stone sword for 10). A Vine Hollow sign sits on the path about 90 m from spawn. F5 cycles village centers when ?debug is on. Saves migrate egSchema v2 to v3 with no loss. No character customization. PROXY High <=150, Low <=62. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
